title: Anytime Training with Schedule-Free Spectral Optimization
summary: Standard neural network training relies on learning-rate schedules tied to a fixed horizon, leading to strong path dependence and costly re-tuning as data availability changes. Schedule-Free (SF) methods address this by removing explicit schedules, yet SF-AdamW, the current state-of-the-art anytime optimizer, consistently underperforms well-tuned AdamW baselines. We propose SF-NorMuon, a schedule-free spectral optimizer that closes this gap: with a single hyperparameter configuration, SF-NorMuon matches or exceeds tuned AdamW on 125M and 772M parameter language models across $1$--$8\times$…
